title: Joomla Apply tidy-up: entries under an entry taken off go with it, and a link entry into a path no entry answers goes
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/brief-joomla.test.mjs

S2: Record the exit code and the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines, and whether these tests are 'ok': 'the pages under a menu heading that is off go with it, in one transaction, whatever the planner retitled them; a home entry never', 'a page under an entry the demo trim took off before Apply goes too, and so does an alias that leads to it', 'a link entry into a path of the site that no entry answers goes; one into a live page, another site or a file stays', 'a link entry is left when the site will not say which prefixes its languages route on, and that is said'.
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 59); the four named tests are 'ok' (since TCH #1013, PR #1040, the judge takes no entry off: a heading is off because the customer unticked it or it was off already).

selectors.engine: apps/tracy-web/src/sites/brief-engines/joomla.js (tidy-up: hiding = unpicked ∪ dead links ∪ stranded ∪ orphaned; takeLinksOff)

evidence: 05/10/2026 local stand, final check: a two-language Tracy Business j6 site made with Apply showed 6 dead links in its main menu (/en and /vi marketing-kit/slide, marketing-kit/styleguide, this-page-does-not-exist): the judge took off the heading 606 but its children 613/615 (retitled 'Home', 'Bread' by the planner) stayed published under it, and url entry 617 (retitled 'About') led to a path no entry answers. The previous check's 0 dead links depended on the model hiding them (ledger L30).
fence: Only entries under one taken off, and url entries into in-site paths that cannot route, are added to what the tidy-up takes off; never a home entry or a system menu, never a language the site does not serve.

tests: the pages under a menu heading that is off go with it, in one transaction, whatever the planner retitled them; a home entry never
a page under an entry the demo trim took off before Apply goes too, and so does an alias that leads to it
a link entry into a path of the site that no entry answers goes; one into a live page, another site or a file stays
a link entry is left when the site will not say which prefixes its languages route on, and that is said
